name: The Westin Riverwalk
insider_take: Nestled along the iconic San Antonio River Walk, The Westin Riverwalk delivers a serene urban escape where the gentle sounds of the river meet the vibrant pulse of one of Texas's most beloved cities.
whats_special: Situated directly on the famous River Walk, guests enjoy private river-level access — a rare luxury in the heart of downtown San Antonio. As part of Marriott's Luminous Collection , The Westin brand brings its signature Heavenly Bed® and wellness-focused amenities, ensuring restorative rest after a day of exploration. Steps from the historic Alamo — one of America's most visited landmarks — and the lively Market Square , the largest Mexican market in the US. The hotel's rooftop pool offers breathtaking panoramic views of the San Antonio skyline and the winding river below.
pro_tip: Request a River Walk-facing room for mesmerizing nighttime views of the illuminated waterway — the ambiance after dark is truly magical. Book during the holiday season to witness the legendary Ford Holiday River Parade & Lighting Ceremony right from your window!
dont_miss: The River Walk itself — stroll the 15-mile network of pathways lined with restaurants, shops, and open-air entertainment, all steps from the hotel door. San Antonio's Historic Missions — a UNESCO World Heritage Site, just a short ride away. The Pearl District — a reimagined 19th-century brewery complex buzzing with farm-to-table dining and weekend farmers' markets.
pros: Prime Riverwalk Location — Situated directly on the iconic San Antonio River Walk, offering guests immediate access to dining, entertainment, and major attractions like the Alamo.
Signature Westin Heavenly Bed — Guests consistently rave about the legendary Heavenly Bed and Heavenly Bath amenities, delivering a deeply restorative sleep experience.
Exceptional On-Site Dining — Features refined restaurant and bar options with beautiful River Walk views, perfect for romantic dinners or casual cocktails.
Wellness-Forward Amenities — Includes a rooftop outdoor pool, fully equipped WestinWORKOUT fitness center, and a curated menu of wellness offerings to keep guests energized.
Marriott Bonvoy & Luminous Benefits — Guests enjoy exclusive WhataHotel! Marriott Luminous perks such as complimentary breakfast, room upgrades, and early check-in/late checkout when available.
cons: High-Traffic Tourist Area — Being on the River Walk means the surrounding area can be lively and crowded, especially on weekends and during festivals, which may not suit guests seeking quiet seclusion.
Parking Costs Extra — Valet and self-parking are available at an additional nightly fee, which is typical for a downtown urban property.
